citation: Buxton OM, Pavlova M, Reid EW, et al. Sleep Restriction for 1 Week Reduces Insulin Sensitivity in Healthy Men. Diabetes. 2010.
protocol: Inpatient 12 days; 5 h vs 10 h in bed per night (sleep restriction), FSIVGTT (0.3 g/kg glucose at 09:00) and euglycaemic clamp after each; salivary cortisol and urinary catecholamines
population: n=20 healthy men, age 26.8+/-5.2 y, BMI 23.3+/-3.1 (11 placebo, 9 modafinil)

reports.marker: insulin sensitivity SI, AIRg, DI, glucose effectiveness

note: Derived FSIVGTT indices, not glucose/insulin time courses. Modafinil vs placebo is a drug factor; sleep restriction (5 h) is the manipulated condition. Salivary cortisol in ng/mL; catecholamines per day.
